results.name: Cruzeiro da Quinta
results.description:
Levantamento fotogramétrico de um cruzeiro quinhentista, localizada no lugar da “Quinta” (Arnoso Santa Maria, V. N. Famalicão).

É um cruzeiro datado de 1569, de encomenda particular. Possui um admirável trabalho escultórico e significado, o que o elevou, desde 20 de Setembro de 2012, à categoria de Imóvel de Interesse Público. Além da iconografia aí presente, pode ainda observar também diversas epígrafes e símbolos. 

SAIBA MAIS: [FAMALICÃO ID](http://famalicaoid.org/inweb/ficha.aspx?ns=215000&id=999)
________________________
“Quinta” Wayside Cross

Photogrammetric survey of wayside cross from the 16th century, located at “Quinta” place (Arnoso Santa Maria, Vila Nova de Famalicão, Portugal).

It is a historic landmark, dated 1569, built by a private individual. It has a astonishing sculpture work and suprise significance, that took it to be classified as "Imóvel de Interesse Público", since 20th September, 2012. 

FIND MORE ABOUT: [FAMALICÃO ID](http://famalicaoid.org/inweb/ficha.aspx?ns=215000&id=999)

results.name: Astana (Астана)
results.description:
this is the city of Astana. Main Features:

* Population: about 1,200,000 (2023).
* Geography: Located on the banks of the Ishim River in the northern part of Kazakhstan.
* Climate: Continental, with cold winters and hot summers.
* Economy: The center of financial, commercial and trade activities in Kazakhstan. 
* Culture: A mixture of traditions of the Kazakh people and modern architecture.
* Architecture: Modern skyscrapers, mosques, museums and monuments.
* Transport: Well-developed public transport infrastructure, including the metro.
* Attractions: Baiterek, Palace of Peace and Accord, Hazret Sultan Mosque.

results.name: Байтерек Астана
results.description: **Байтерек** – уникальный по конструкции, величественный монумент, считающийся визитной карточкой современной **столицы** Казахстана. Полное название этого памятника – Байтерек-Астана. Для казахов он стал символом наступления нового этапа в истории страны, а мировое сообщество воспринимает Байтерек как воплощение независимого государства **Казахстан**.

results.name: 'The Lady with the Dog' Sculpture Scan
results.description:
Small architectural form “The Lady with the Dog” is inspired by the character from Anton Chekhov’s short story of the same name. Located in the Yesil District of Astana, in the Shubar microdistrict (near the Avicenna residential complex and Baiterek metro station). The sculptor, commissioner, and date of installation are unknown.

  Processed in RealityCapture from 469 images on Medium quality settings
